shape.description: integer or sequence of integers giving the new shape, which must match the size of the input array. If any single dimension is given size ``-1``, it will be replaced with a value such that the output has the correct size.

order.description: ``'F'`` or ``'C'``, specifies whether the reshape should apply column-major (fortran-style, ``"F"``) or row-major (C-style, ``"C"``) order; default is ``"C"``. JAX does not support ``order="A"``.

copy.description: unused by JAX; JAX always returns a copy, though under JIT the compiler may optimize such copies away.

output.description: reshaped copy of input array with the specified shape.
